race_context: The 'Frontier School Board' seats belong to Frontier School Corporation, a rural district in White County with its office in Chalmers {nces_fr}{idoe_dir}. It runs two schools: Frontier Elementary (pre-K to grade 6) in Brookston and Frontier Jr-Sr High School (grades 7-12) in Chalmers {idoe_dir}. State data count 680 students in 2025-26, up from 666 in 2024-25 {idoe_enr}. The state's 2025-26 school directory, dated March 2026, lists Frederick Unsicker as superintendent {idoe_dir}; Daniel A. Sichting was superintendent through at least June 2024, per the state audit {sboa_fr_2024}.

How members are elected: county results show every Frontier board race since 2020 as a single at-large contest, with two members elected in 2020 and 2024 and three in 2022, which points to a five-member board elected at large in staggered four-year terms {wc_2020_results}{wc_2022_results}{wc_2024_results}. This guide could not reach the district's website to confirm the board's size or plan.

Seats on the 2026 ballot: three at-large seats; the county's candidate list names the race 'Frontier School Board, At Large (3 seats)' {wc_cand_2026}{in_list}. These appear to be the seats filled in 2022, when Laura A. Bell, Shelley Christopher and Jared Rosenbarger were the only three candidates for three seats {wc_2022_results}. The other two seats were filled in 2024, when David Rosenbarger (1,534 votes) and Stephanie Laorange (1,433) were elected unopposed for two seats {wc_2024_results}.

Who is running: four candidates for three seats. Laura Bell and Jared Rosenbarger, who won these seats in 2022, are running again; Shelley Christopher, the third member elected in 2022, is not on the 2026 list {wc_cand_2026}{wc_2022_results}. The newcomers are David Cosgray and Carlie Lehe {wc_cand_2026}. Cosgray and Rosenbarger filed as Republicans; Bell and Lehe filed with no party {wc_cand_2026}. This guide could not confirm the current board roster, so it is not certain that Bell and Rosenbarger still hold their seats.
Board leadership: the state audit lists Robert Andie Mears as board president in 2022, Shelley Christopher in 2023 and David Rosenbarger in 2024 {sboa_fr_2024}.

Issues: this guide found no news coverage, board minutes or district statements on Frontier's 2025-26 budget, the effect of the 2025 property-tax law (SEA 1), referendums, buildings or test scores. The district website did not load during research, and the board's BoardDocs pages, if any, could not be reached.
Forums: this guide found no 2026 candidate forum, questionnaire or news coverage of the candidates' views.
